    • Independent clinical testing.

      At CurrentBody we develop beauty technology based on leading clinical evidence, and then subject our products to rigorous testing to prove their efficacy.

    CurrentBody Veritace®-tested LED clinical studies

    SGS Report — Veritace®-tested LEDs (633nm / 830nm / 1072nm)

    56-day study on Series 2 LED Face Mask, 35 subjects, measurements at D14/D28/D42/D56

    Usage: Daily for 28 days then 5x/week for 28 days, 10 mins per session.

    Setting: Single-centre, controlled lab (21±2°C, 50±10% RH), 30-min acclimatisation.

    Equipment: VISIA-CR imaging, Primos-CR 3D wrinkle mapping, Corneometer, Tewameter, Cutometer, Mexameter, Sebumeter, Colorimeter, Glossymeter, Dermalab ultrasound, MoistureMap, expert clinical grading (0–9 scale), self-assessment questionnaire.

    Stats: SPSS 28.0, t-test/Wilcoxon, p<0.05

    (All results at D56, all statistically significant.)

    Read the full report here.

    Eurofins Report - Veritace®-tested LEDs (633nm / 830nm / 1072nm)

    56-day dermatological study on Series 2 LED Face Mask & Series 2 Neck & Décolletage Mask, 30 female  subjects (aged 40-55, mild-moderate signs of photoaging), measurements at D0 and D56.

    Usage: 5x/week for 56 days.

    Setting: Single-centre under dermatological control, dermatologist skin exam at each visit.

    Equipment: Antera 3D Pro texture/wrinkle mapping, Cutometer, Corneometer, Tewameter, Mexameter, Colorimeter, Glossmeter, Sebumeter, VISIA 7 imaging, clinical grading (10-point scale), self-assessment questionnaire.

    Stats: Shapiro-Wilk normality, then t-test/Wilcoxon, p<0.05

    Read the full report here.

    Intertek — LEDs (620-660nm) in CurrentBody Hair Regrowth Device

    84-day clinical study, 31 subjects (aged 24–54, mild-moderate hair loss/thinning), measurements at D0/D2/D56/D58/D84/D86

    Usage: Once daily, 10 mins per session (auto shut-off), scalp clean and dry.

    Setting: Single-centre, constant temp/humidity room, 30-min acclimatisation.

    Equipment: Dermoscope DERMDOC HR, TrichoScan analysis, 60-comb hair loss count, Sebumeter, Vapometer, DermaLab, digital camera, expert visual hair density grading (0–7 scale), self-assessment questionnaire.

    Stats: SPSS, Shapiro-Wilk normality, paired t-test/Wilcoxon, p<0.05

    Read the full report here.

    University of Manchester Study Protocol

    The Centre for Dermatology Research at the University of Manchester is conducting a 12-week open clinical study led by Dr. Abigail K Langton and Dr. Mark D Farrar, investigating whether Veritace®-tested LEDs at wavelengths of 633nm, 830nm, and 1072nm —  delivered through the CurrentBody Series 2 LED Face Mask — can improve signs of photoaging in human skin.

    Participants: Minimum of 20 healthy females, aged 35–55, Fitzpatrick skin types I–III, with moderate facial and forearm photoaging. Measurements at Week 0, Week 6, and Week 12.

    Usage: 10 minutes, five times per week on face and forearm for 12 weeks.

    Setting: Single-centre, Centre for Dermatology Research, University of Manchester.

    Equipment: VISIA photography, clinical photoaging grading (0–8 scale), Corneometer (hydration), Tewameter (TEWL), Cutometer (elasticity), L*a*b* colorimetry, 3mm punch biopsies with haematoxylin & eosin staining and immunostaining for FRM deposition, total elastic fibres, total fibrillar collagens, pro-collagen I, and Ki67.

    Read the full report here.

    56-day study on Veritace®-tested yellow (590nm), green (532nm) and deep near-infrared (1072nm) light in the Multi-Light Mask, 30 female subjects per light mode, aged 30-45, measurements at D0/D56.

    Usage: 5x/week for 8 consecutive weeks, 10 mins per session.


    Setting: Single-centre (Eurofins Cosmetics & Personal Care Italy), controlled lab conditions, dermatologist-supervised (Dr. Laura Mainardi).


    Equipment includes: VISIA PRIMOS (Canfield) eye bag volume & wrinkle mapping across 4 zones (forehead, nasolabial folds, crow's feet, undereye), C-Cube (Pixience) 3D skin texture, Cutometer MPA 580 (R2/R5/R7 elasticity, F4 firmness), Corneometer CM 825, Tewameter TM Hex, Antera 3D Pro pigmentation & redness, Glossymeter GL 200, Sebumeter SM815,

    Light modes tested independently: Yellow (590nm) | Green (532nm) | Deep Near-Infrared (1072nm).

    Stats: Shapiro-Wilk normality test, bilateral Student t-test/Wilcoxon, p<0.05.

    Read the full report here.
